from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def read_note(name: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of the file `name` within the `notes` directory.

    Names are untrusted. Only files strictly contained inside `notes`
    (or its subdirectories) relative to the current working directory
    can be read. If the file is missing, unreadable, or resolves outside
    `notes`, an empty string is returned.
    """
    try:
        notes_dir = Path("notes").resolve()
        if not notes_dir.is_dir():
            return ""
        target = (notes_dir / name).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(notes_dir) or target == notes_dir:
            return ""
        if not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeError):
        return ""


def test_read_simple_note(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "test.txt").write_text("hello world", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_note("test.txt") == "hello world"


def test_read_nested_note(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sub_dir / "b.txt").write_text("nested content", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_note("sub/b.txt") == "nested content"


def test_missing_file_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()

    assert read_note("nonexistent.txt") == ""


def test_directory_target_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)

    assert read_note("sub") == ""


def test_path_traversal_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()

    assert read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""


def test_absolute_path_outside_notes_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    outside_file = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    outside_file.write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_note(str(outside_file.resolve())) == ""


def test_symlink_escape_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    outside_file = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    outside_file.write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")

    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    symlink = notes_dir / "link.txt"
    symlink.symlink_to(outside_file)

    assert read_note("link.txt") == ""


def test_notes_directory_missing(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    assert read_note("test.txt") == ""


def test_empty_filename_returns_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()

    assert read_note("") == ""
    assert read_note(".") == ""
